note: Both Chinese components have now been measured on an approved external source at their shipped operating points. Neither clears the gate: both hold the false-positive promise comfortably, but recall collapses on unseen generators. No high-confidence population claim may be made for Chinese. English remains unmeasured.

caveats: The catalog note claims 48.7% recall on DetectRL-ZH; on this external corpus the same asset at the same 0.99 threshold recalls 9.0%.

A properly calibrated threshold (0.97, chosen on NLPCC-2025 dev) gives external recall 0.273 — see properly_calibrated_alternative. The 0.90/0.500 figure from the diagnostic sweep was selection-on-test and overstates it by nearly 2x.

properly_calibrated_alternative.method: Threshold selected on NLPCC-2025 dev (the shared task's designated calibration split), reported once on SemEval-2024 Task 8 Chinese. The two corpora are disjoint, so this is not selection-on-test.
properly_calibrated_alternative.note: Lowering the gate from 0.99 to 0.97 would raise external Chinese recall from 0.090 to 0.273 while the false-positive upper bound stays at 0.0022 — far inside the 0.01 budget. It still does not clear the 0.5 recall floor, so the release gate remains unmet.
properly_calibrated_alternative.supersedes: An earlier diagnostic sweep read 0.90 / recall 0.500 off the reporting corpus itself. Calibrated properly the choice is 0.97 / recall 0.273 — a concrete measure of how much selection-on-test inflates the figure, and why the contract prohibits it.

caveats: In-corpus NLPCC-2025 test recall is 0.626; on unseen generators it is 0.331.
Scoring was cross-checked document by document against the Dart production scorer (max delta 1.6e-15).

approved_source_coverage_gap.finding: Of the three approved external sources, RAID contains no Chinese, and M4GT-Bench ships the same M4 Chinese subset as SemEval-2024 Task 8 — so there is exactly one Chinese corpus available, not three, and it is not an independent second reading.
approved_source_coverage_gap.threat_model_mismatch: That corpus was generated by chatGPT and davinci in 2023, while both Chinese components target DeepSeek-V3 / GPT-4 era writing. Passing on it would not evidence current coverage.
approved_source_coverage_gap.action_required: Add an approved external source covering modern Chinese generators, or state the limitation explicitly in the contract.

multilingual_expansion.finding: The char n-gram pipeline extends to other languages unchanged, but no approved corpus supports shipping one.

corpus_integrity.note: M4GT SubtaskA_multilingual.jsonl carries records whose binary label contradicts their generator field. prepare_m4gt_language.py refuses these rather than guessing which field is right.

trained_but_not_shipped.why_not_shipped: The test split is a random split of one single-generator corpus. Chinese showed exactly this pattern before collapsing from 0.626 to 0.331 on a genuinely external corpus. No second Indonesian corpus with different generators exists among approved sources.
Fails the 1% false-positive target even in-corpus, on only 1400 training documents.
